instruction: A barrel cactus in a simple pot: a squat rounded ribbed cylindrical cactus body with clearly defined vertical ribs and rows of spine clusters along the ridges, in a plain round pot. Print-friendly clean geometry.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a barrel cactus. A barrel cactus in a simple pot: a squat rounded ribbed cylindrical cactus body with clearly defined vertical ribs and rows of spine clusters along the ridges, in a plain round pot. Print-friendly clean geometry. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
